comment: The single source of Day by Word's colors, shapes, spacing, and type sizes (docs/design.md). scripts/generate-tokens.swift writes the app's color assets and the web's tokens.css from this file; never edit those outputs by hand.

background.use: the page or screen behind everything

surfaceSoft.use: secondary buttons, chips, and day cells

line.use: hairline borders around cards; never text

accent.use: the dawn accent: the primary action, today's date, the next reading's plan label, and links

onAccent.use: text and symbols on the accent

accentTint.use: the selected section and quiet celebrations; text on it is always text, never accent

type.comment: Point sizes at the default text size. In the app each scales with Dynamic Type relative to the named text style, up to AX5; on the web sizes are rem (16 px = 1 rem) and scale with the reader's text size.

referenceList.use: references in a card with several readings, and in lists

label.use: a plan's label above a reading
